name: Shinda Classmate kara Koibumi ga Todoita.
original_name: 死んだクラスメイトから恋文が届いた。
source:
I got a letter from my dead classmate.

It was a wonderful love letter.

It said he loved me.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23708]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我收到一封来自死去同学的信。

这是一封美妙的情书。

它说他爱我。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23708]Freem![/url]]
